bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money for Red River mediation agreement.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; RED RIVER MEDIATION AGREEMENT.

$350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for grants for up to 50 percent of the cost to implement the Red River mediation agreement.
additions: $350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for grants for up to 50 percent of the cost to implement the Red River mediation agreement.
